name: "Mini Zen" in the Park
description: A wonderful start to the weekend for little ones. This free program offers yoga and meditation for children up to 13 in a beautiful garden setting.
longDescription:
"Mini Zen" in the Park is a free children's program designed to introduce young participants to the principles of yoga and meditation. Organized by local wellness advocates, the initiative aims to provide accessible well-being practices for children up to 13 years old, fostering calm and focus through gentle movement and mindfulness exercises. The program is offered as a regular community event, promoting healthy habits from an early age within a natural environment.

Attendees can expect a relaxed and engaging atmosphere, with sessions tailored for younger age groups. The program runs for a defined period on Saturday morning, offering a peaceful start to the weekend. The setting in the Jardins do Palácio de Cristal provides an expansive outdoor space, allowing children to connect with nature while participating in the activities. The sessions are conducted in Portuguese, suitable for local families and visitors familiar with the language.

Participation in "Mini Zen" is free of charge, though advance registration is required to secure a spot. The Jardins do Palácio de Cristal are easily accessible, located within walking distance from several central Porto points. Various bus lines serve the area, and it is a moderate walk from the Carolina Michaelis metro station. The park grounds are generally accessible for strollers and individuals with mobility considerations.
